import html # Predefined template for rendering the user profile. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{username}

{bio}

Status: {status_message}
""" def render_user_profile(username: str, bio: str, status_message: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. bio : str A user-written biography, possibly spanning multiple sentences. status_message : str A brief current status message. Returns ------- str The profile HTML with all user-supplied content escaped to prevent XSS. Raises ------ ValueError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, bio, status_message)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape user input to neutralize any potential XSS payloads safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message, quote=True) # Format the sanitized data into the template rendered = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, bio=safe_bio, status_message=safe_status ) return rendered.strip()
